Issue 4 - Whether re-assessment proceedings can be initiated based on change of opinion High Court ruling • The claim of deduction under Section 80JJAA was disclosed in the Tax audit report of the taxpayer. Tata 2020 (‘TOLA’) are applicable to AYs 2015-16 and onwards High Court ruling • TOLA provisions are applicable only to the AYs for which the time limit for issue of notice under section 148 was expiring on or before March 31, 2021.
